case_name: D.Krishnamohan vs Honble Secretary Honble Supreme Court ...
author: Chief Justice

paragraphs.text:
INHERENT JURISDICTION

 REVIEW PETITION (CIVIL) NO. 237 OF 2022

 WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) NO.297 OF 2019

 D. KRISHNA MOHAN …Petitioner

 Versus

 HON’BLE SECRETARY,
 HON’BLE SUPREME COURT LEGAL SERVICE
 COMMITTEE AND ORS. …Respondents

 O R D E R
Application for listing Review Petition in open Court is rejected.
Since the said application is rejected, no permission to appear and argue
 in-person is granted.
We have gone through the grounds raised in the Review Petition and do
 not find any reason to justify interference.
This Review Petition is, therefore, dismissed.
………………………………CJI.
[Uday Umesh Lalit]

 …………………………………J.
 [M.R. Shah]

1st November, 2022.
